name: @wenathlan/stealhead.sol
description: stealhead Sol theme (the universal interface of the FPS game platform): the match, ranking, weapons and world pages over the shared Sol design engine; static-first, deployable to vercel, netlify, cloudflare, capacitor and every static host
_comment: the theme manifest: the deploy root owns its package. the specifier set mirrors the family theme machinery (devthink/Sol) so every theme of the family builds with the same toolchain. this package is NEVER published to npm, github packages or any registry - the published package is the central @wenathlan/stealhead (repository root) which ships the game logics without Sol/. the interface sources are tsx/ts only: designs in tsx, logic in ts, zero js at the web root.
